text:
This mania of knowing myself an angel,

without age,

without death in which to live myself,

without mercy for my name

or for my bones that weep wandering.


And who does not have a love?

And who does not rejoice among poppies?

And who does not possess a fire, a death,

a fear, something horrible,

even if it were with feathers,

even if it were with smiles?


Sinister delirium to love a shadow.

The shadow does not die.

And my love

only embraces what flows

like lava from hell:

a silent lodge,

ghosts in sweet erection,

priests of foam,

and above all angels,

angels beautiful as knives

that rise in the night

and devastate hope.

translation.title: This Mania of Knowing Myself an Angel...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the anaphora of who does not and the angelic violence of the close.
